cartoon.element_ids: element id = manifest element id = index into the track; per-element appearance below is keyed by it
cartoon.note: Motion is the cartoon track (single source of motion); nothing here duplicates it.

rest_field.rule: u = clamp(-phi / w, 0, 1); rho_rest = u^2 (3 - 2u); normalised radius-0.5 rest frame; outside 0; trilinear, voxel centre lo + (i + .5) h

main.rule: r = R^T (x - T) / s;  rho_main = S(rho_rest(r) / 0.18) * (1 + 0.32 (2 n(o + k*r) - 1)) * c(t)
main.seed: generation 0: mix32(6 XOR ((id + 1) * 0x27d4eb2d)); children inherit the root seed

concentration.rule: c(t) = c_thin(t) * c_shrink(e, t) * g_swap(e, t)
concentration.c_shrink: 1 - 0.5 * S(p), p = (t - (t_end - shrink_T)) / shrink_T, t_end = (first_sample + sample_count - 1) / 30; only elements with shrink_T
concentration.g_swap: 1 + (g0 - 1) * (1 - S((t - birth) / T)); split children only

fine.rule: prog = S(age/1.8); c = anchor + normal (.035 + .09 prog) + drift prog; radii = base (.72 + .28 prog); q = (frame^T (r - c)) / radii; rho = .22 S((t - max(birth, .3)) / .6) max(0, 1 - q.q)^2 (.35 + .65 n((r - c + anchor) 2.8, patch seed))^2 S(max(y, 0)/.035); after the parent's split: frozen parent frame translated by (v + (0, .15, 0)) tau, radii x (1 + .2 S(tau/1.5)), amplitude x (1 - S(tau/1.5)); prog frozen at the swap

compose.rule: rho = cap (1 - exp(-(M + F) / cap)); M = sum main + sum spikes, F = sum fine; main-only = cap (1 - exp(-M / cap))

optics.rule: tau along key from the composed density (thickness 3); illum = (.28 + .90 exp(-.9 tau)) * ((1 - .3 edge) + .3 edge (.3 + .7 facing)); edge = S(|grad rho| / 7); colour = source * illum, alpha = 1 - exp(-3 rho ds)
